:::{#sol-prereq-inequalities}

1. Every integer $n > 6$, that is, $n \ge 7$.
   Subtract $n$ from both sides and add 7 to get $2n > 12$,
   then divide both sides by 2.
2. False.
   Multiplying both sides of an inequality by a negative number reverses it,
   so $a < b$ gives $-a > -b$.
   For example, $1 < 2$ but $-1 > -2$.

Proofs in the course often chain inequalities like these.
To review, read @thm-neg-ineq and @thm-mult-ineq.

:::
